what: On press it squishes to .95 and springs back to full size in one beat (.42s). Among buttons in the same row, data-on and aria-pressed move to the one pressed

options.bpm: Tempo speed — all lengths are in beats, so this one value changes the rhythm together, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
options.group: If present, only one of the parts inside the same parent is on at a time (pad row)
